ns2:section.sectionText: The main theme of the course will be how individuals respond to incentives. We will study policies that have succeeded, or failed, to offer the right incentives to individuals (whether in a household, a firm, a village, or a country) and examine the impact of these policy decisions. For more information please see: http://app.studyabroad.illinois.edu/?go=saoSCABurkinaFaso. Class will be held Monday evenings on March 12, April 2, April 16, and April 30, 2012, 7 to 9:30 p.m. The place has yet to be determined.
